workflow.title: Diff CRM contacts missing from newsletter list (report and send to Nadia)
workflow.goal: Read the CRM sheet and the newsletter list, skip CRM contacts marked unsubscribed, report which remaining CRM contacts are not in the newsletter list, save the diff as an artifact, and send the diff by email to nadia@yogaflowstudio.com. Make no changes to any sheet and append no rows.

assumptions: The crm sheet is the Mindbody contact export with email, name, company, tags, unsubscribed.
The newsletter sheet stands in for the Mailchimp audience.
Emails are matched ignoring case and spaces, as rows.reconcile does.
Unsubscribed CRM contacts are left out of the diff entirely.
The diff is sent to nadia@yogaflowstudio.com as the requested recipient; outbox.send asks a person before dispatch when run live.
risks: Sheet exports may contain duplicate or malformed emails that are reported as-is.
The emailed diff contains customer contact details sent to a third-party address.
The report is a snapshot; it does not make any change to either list.
successCriteria: Every reported contact is in crm, has unsubscribed not true, and is absent from the newsletter sheet.
No rows are appended to any sheet.
A diff artifact is written for review.
The diff is delivered to nadia@yogaflowstudio.com and the delivered message is re-read and verified.
